phases.name: breeding
phases.note: BLOCKER, not evidence: no permissively licensed source with a dated breeding or calving season for ZA was found. The 01-01 to 12-31 window is a full-year placeholder that asserts nothing about timing. A Kruger tourism page gives a Jan-Apr birth window, but it is not openly licensed and was not used.

sources.note: Country facet with 6,248 records; presence only, not establishment means. Countries with presence records in sub-Saharan Africa are used; non-African countries (DE, CZ, DK, NL, MY), Réunion (RE), unknown (ZZ) and Sudan (SD) are excluded.

external.note: iNaturalist 42405 and NCBI 9970 from Wikidata P3151 and P685; GBIF 2441034 from GBIF match API and Wikidata P846; TSN 328707 from Wikidata P830. All checked as species rank on 2026-10-31.

range.native.note: Derived in two steps. (1) Wikipedia: the species 'ranged throughout most of sub-Saharan Africa' historically. (2) GBIF PRESENT occurrence records (CC0 and CC BY) with a country facet list 32 sub-Saharan countries with records. Presence is not native status: no IUCN or other range-map source with native status was accessible under an open licence. Introduced or captive populations (e.g. DE, CZ, DK, NL) are excluded by hand. Sudan (SD, 29 records) is excluded as ambiguous. Treat this as a provisional list, not a verified native range.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Walk for grazing movement; Gallop for stampede and flight (Wikipedia describes a large, aggressive bovine; the stampede and outrunning lions are from the ADW account, which is not cited here). Gallop is included as a mode the flee action uses.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Ruminant bovid; endotherm (judgement from mammalian class).

traits.skin.note: Fur ranges from rusty to black.

traits.nest_type.note: No nest; calves born in herd.

traits.perching.note: Not a perching animal; grazing ungulate.

traits.mass_kg.note: Mean of two Wikipedia figures: the Cape buffalo male range 650 to 900 kg (midpoint 775 kg) and the Cape female maximum of 500 kg. (775 + 500) / 2 = 637.5 kg. Typical adult only, not a maximum.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Lower bound: forest buffalo 265 kg (Wikipedia, weight range 265 to 320 kg). Upper bound: Cape male 900 kg.

traits.length_m.note: Head-body midpoint of Cape buffalo, 210 to 300 cm (2.55 m), plus tail midpoint of 55 to 120 cm (0.875 m), total 3.425 m rounded to 3.4 m. Nose-to-tail convention as the schema requires.

traits.shoulder_height_m.note: Midpoint of Cape buffalo shoulder height 140 to 160 cm.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Wikipedia: 'the lifespan is about 12 years in the wild.' Typical wild lifespan, not the maximum. The ADW account reports a wild average age at death of about 11 years in one study and a maximum of 22 years; ADW is CC BY-NC-SA and was not cited for this value.

traits.diet.note: Wikipedia: 'primarily feeding on grass and dietary fiber', a ruminant grazer. Graze 0.9 and browse 0.1 are authored estimates: the source gives no percentage. Ryan and Jordaan report feeding time about 9.5 h per day and do not report diet composition.

traits.social.note: Herds from a few individuals to over a thousand; floodplain herds up to 2,000.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Cathemeral: Ryan and Jordaan (2005) recorded feeding at night (44.5% of activity at night vs 32.0% reported elsewhere) and daytime rest (28.4% vs 16.0%) in three herds in one Kruger region in 1991 and 1992. Not generalised across the range.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: Wikipedia describes a large, aggressive animal with cases of human injury; Mob is the closest schema value. Not a direct quote.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement, not sourced: a large, aggressive animal with cases of human injury. Set mid-high.

habitat.use.note: Authored: grazing ruminant on the ground. No time-budget source was checked. Aquatic use (wallowing) is not included.

habitat.resources.note: Graze: grass-dominated diet. Water: the Wikipedia article says the species prefers semi-arid environments with permanent water within 20 to 40 km. Shelter: authored; the species uses woodland and shade, but the cited texts do not describe shelter use.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Avoider: most savanna populations are restricted to protected areas and hunting zones.

seasonal.strategy.note: No dormancy or migration in the cited texts.

seasonal.phases.note: Placeholder only: a full-year breeding window that is NOT a sourced calving calendar. Gestation about 340 days (Wikipedia) is the only sourced timing input. Do not read this window as seasonal evidence.

behavior.note: Program fsm-ground-forager-v1 with food_tag graze and daytime rest window 10 to 90 degrees. Limitation: the program rests in the day, while the source reports a cathemeral pattern with night feeding. The program cannot express night rest or split-cycle activity.

look.note: Authored: blocky quadruped body, dark brown palette. The horns and boss are not yet modelled. Judgement only.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored: shade or thicket shelter is not described in the cited texts; see habitat.resources.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Only the adult stage is modelled; the Wikipedia article describes calves weaned at 10 to 18 months.
